text:
morgan: Heads up — embeddings in eu-west1 started returning 503s for short queries around 02:10 UTC. Error spike on production tail: p50 fine, p95->p99 error rate up. Suspect regression from yesterday's quant build. I'm preparing a hotfix image that reverts the quant path to v2.3.2 (safe binary). Need expedited approvals to push during the change window. Can skip canary if we get fast consensus, otherwise 5% canary then rollforward. /cc @dave-ops :eyes:

liam: How severe? user-facing? any customers hit?

morgan: It's user-facing for a subset of low-token embedding calls (length < 32). Not all customers — about 3% of requests in eu-west1. A couple of support tickets. Tokenizer and infra are fine. No schema changes.

sara: Any cache invalidation required? Will this cause cold K/V misses?

morgan: No schema change. KV cache remains compatible, but prefetched prefixes may misalign for the reverted kernel; recommend draining prefix cache on the pool post-deploy (small downtime for warmups).

liam: Rollback plan? what's the blast radius if the revert fails?

morgan: Rollback is to re-deploy the most recent good image (v2.3.4) which is already in registry and tested. We can circuit-break traffic with routing policy within 2m if metrics go red. I've prepared a checklist.

morgan: Deploy request posted: /deploy request --service embeddings-eu --image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix --strategy canary=5%:5m or skip-canary=true (expedite) --reason "503s short-embeds regress"

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6370123456 created by morgan. Approvals required: eng-leads (liam,sara) + ops-oncall (dave-ops). Click to approve: /approve 6370123456 or react :thumbsup:. Preflight checks: integration-tests: PASS, smoke: WARNING (503 observed), canary-sanity: N/A until deployed.

dave-ops: I'm on call and can approve for ops with condition: we do a 5% canary for 3 minutes then evaluate metrics. If error rate < 0.5% and latency stable, roll to 25% then 100%. I'll monitor.

liam: I can approve for eng if dave is monitoring. Prefer the 5% canary then 25% after green. Approving now. /approve 6370123456

sara: Approving for docs/QA. Please add a short release note for support. /approve 6370123456

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: liam, sara, dave-ops. Preflight gate satisfied. Starting canary deploy: embeddings-eu -> redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix (canary 5%). Canary window: 180s. Logs streaming available at https://deploy.internal/logs/6370123456

morgan: kicking off drain for 5% pool then apply image. command: 
```
kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix -n prod-eu
```

deploy-bot: Canary started; pods updating (3 -> 1-3 new). Canary metrics (live): requests/sec 120 -> 118, errors 2 -> 0 (momentary). Latency stable.

dave-ops: Seeing error rate drop in canary. Monitoring traces. :thumbsup:

liam: Can we expand to 25%? if dave is ok.

dave-ops: green on canary. ramp to 25% for 4m, then full if still green.

deploy-bot: Canary 5% -> 25% ramp started. Window 240s.

morgan: note: after ramp we'll drain prefix-cache on the larger pool: /infra/cache/drain --service embeddings-eu --pool "default"

deploy-bot: 25% window complete. Metrics: error rate 0.02% (within SLO), latency at p95 +2ms. No new alerts.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% now. Progress: 40% -> 70% -> 100%.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. All pods stable. Post-deploy checks: healthchecks PASS, e2e-smoke PASS, traffic switch OK.

morgan: Done. Drained prefix cache and warmed. No regressions observed in next 10m.

liam: Thanks — please add a line in release notes: "Embeddings: hotfix revert to v2.3.2 to address 503s on short embeddings in eu-west1. Performed canary ramp; prefix cache drain post-deploy."

sara: I'll file a short support blurb and send to oncall docs.

morgan: tagging this thread for postmortem: we'll follow up with root cause and plan to rework the quant kernel to avoid future reverts. Closing once release note pushed. :white_check_mark:
